definitions.explanation: A small place where things are made or repaired by hand or with simple machines. The same characters read こうじょう mean a factory of any size, usually a large one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{工場|こうば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}んでいる→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
examples.english: My father runs a small workshop.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうば}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧くる。
examples.english: The sound of machines comes from the workshop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下町|したまち}→下町：04193_shitamachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工場|こうば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧まね⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In the workshops of the old downtown there are craftsmen with skills even big companies can't copy.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
{工場|こうじょう} and {工場|こうば} are written the same. こうじょう is the general and official word (an automobile factory); こうば is a small, family-run workshop and sounds warmer and more old-fashioned. When written without furigana, こうじょう is the default reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{町工場|まちこうば}→町工場：26008_machikouba⟧: small neighborhood factory
- {工場|こうば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work in a workshop
